about: Booking a Crab Bike (docs/design/08-ride-hailing.md). Shared by the server (server/internal/ridehail), which charges and pays, and the game (src/game/rides.ts), which shows the same estimate before booking. Money is in xu, whole numbers. A fare is base + per_metre for each metre of straight line from the pickup to the destination, rounded to round. cut_percent of every fare goes to nobody (the platform): it is what makes moving xu between two of your own accounts a loss. Times are seconds, distances metres.
